scope: Real observer/watchdog/dispatch/control with mocked providers; offline SSH containers and WordPress/MariaDB/browser
verified: Normal alarm dispatched before test; separate result and receipt ledgers
Alarm failure remains visible even when test is accepted
Test failure does not discard normal alarm receipt
Stopped request transfer and stopped observer do not fabricate acceptance
Dispatch lock reports normal delivery failure and test processing error
Pending work resumes once; expired test is blocked
Stopped result pull retains prior report; stale UI disables tests and labels history
Observer container restart does not resend completed alarm/test
Recovery cancels normal alarm receipt when its polling schedule is due
test_time_controls: Expiry/staleness use aged fixtures; cancellation makes the fixture poll schedule due. Not a long-duration outage measurement.
